entries.zh: 灶口（炉灶进火之口；另本作灶嘴）
entries.en: mouth of the cooking stove; firebox opening

entries.zh: 灶嘴（灶口，烧火之口）；灶、炉灶

entries.en: kitchen; the place by the hearth

entries.notes: M 栏有 [疑:heng/ferg] 且官话对音 guièn tān 与汉字对不上，据西语词头 cocido aparte 与汉字推定。

entries.zh: 火长（船上掌火煮饭者、伙夫长）

馆夫（官馆厨役，为官长司炊者）
entries.en: cook of the mandarin's hall; kitchen servant at an official residence
to build (a house), raising it day by day

entries.en: sincerity, honesty; trustworthy — to give credit, believe
entries.notes: M 栏有 [疑:feng/seng]，据官话对音 chèng 与汉字诚推定。

entries.en: to be trusted (have credit); to forgive, be understanding
proof, credentials; to rely on; credit standing
to believe on (a basis); to rely upon

孚契（朋友相孚相契、彼此相信）
entries.en: bond of trust between friends; to believe one's friend
